body: This should likely be updated. But it could be removed completely if we implemented transpose.
I think it should be possible to implement transpose by multiplying the scale by -1.

This is not the right way to implement it. If I understand correctly, this is just used to make sure `has_alternative_tile` returns `true` even if tiles are transformed. Instead, you should modify the implementation of `TileSetSceneCollectionSource::has_alternative_tile` so that it ignores the transfomation bits instead.

You should add the rotation to the current one, and multiply the scale by the current one, instead of erasing it. Otherwise this means the original scale/rotation will not be applied even if there are no transform (which is compat-breaking).
Yes. Though for the scale it should be a multiplication, not an addition.
